## How the Numbers Compare With Previous Midterms

Trump's current standing is weaker than it was before the 2018 midterm elections.

At a comparable point before those elections, Civiqs polling showed Trump on 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, for a net rating of minus 10.

His current national net approval rating of minus 24 leaves him substantially worse off than he was heading into his first midterm election.
